semanticReview.formulaAndElementAggregation: Not authorized by this header-only audit. Chemical composition, isotopes, charge and stoichiometry require a separate retention proof.
semanticReview.units: No inferred unit conversion. Molar mass and physical-constant fields require checked source/target unit conventions.
semanticReview.identifiers: CAS, PubChem, DrugBank, InChI and SMILES must retain exact strings and native target role; several need a native section rather than the root template.
semanticReview.medicineScope: Infobox Médicament also describes commercial products, formulations, legal controls and treatment information. Do not assume it is equivalent to a single molecular compound.
semanticReview.unmappedFields: Any unsupported nonempty field blocks whole-call migration, never silently dropped.
semanticReview.computedDefaults: French identification models can read Wikidata when arguments are absent. Those implicit dynamic values are not safe to invent or replace from article prose.
